about.title: A jazz club and a listening bar, behind the same door.

salas.title: Two rooms
salas.body: Lenox is the front room: a listening bar with no ticket and no reservation, vinyl selectors and craft cocktails. Seating is first come, first served. Parker is the room inside, where the concerts happen: small capacity and the stage a few steps away.

programa.title: The programming
programa.body: Live music Tuesday through Saturday: jazz, blues, soul, funk and latin jazz, with Mexican and international acts. Tuesdays are jam nights and entry is free. Some Saturdays the same artist plays twice, at 7:30 and 10:30 p.m.

llegar.title: Hours and how to get here
llegar.body: General Prim 100, corner of Milán 14, Colonia Juárez, one block from Paseo de la Reforma. Lenox opens at 6 p.m. and Parker at 9 p.m., Tuesday through Saturday; we close Sundays and Mondays. We have no parking of our own: there are meters and lots less than two blocks away.

lenox.subtitle: The listening bar at Parker & Lenox.
lenox.metaTitle: Lenox — Vinyl Listening Bar in Mexico City | Parker & Lenox
lenox.metaDescription: A listening bar with vinyl selectors, hi-fi sound and craft cocktails in Colonia Juárez. No ticket, no reservation, Tuesday to Saturday from 6 p.m.
lenox.intro: Lenox is the front room at Parker & Lenox: a listening bar in Colonia Juárez, Mexico City, where the music plays on hi-fi and someone chooses it record by record.
lenox.pointer: Looking for live music? That happens inside, at <link>Parker · Live Music</link>.

entrar.title: Getting in
entrar.body: No ticket and no reservation. Seating is first come, first served, subject to availability, and if we're full we'll put you on the waitlist. We open Tuesday through Saturday from 6 p.m.; we close Sundays and Mondays.

barra.title: The bar and the kitchen
barra.body: The house cocktails and the kitchen menu are served at Lenox too. It's the same kitchen that serves the room inside.

sesiones.title: Selectors
sesiones.empty: No sessions announced right now. When there are, they'll show up here.

banners.ohjazz: Jazz beyond the club — Oh! Jazz

hero.whatA: A jazz club and listening bar in the heart of Mexico City. Great music, craft cocktails, exceptional food, and an immersive sound experience.
hero.hoursA: Lenox opens Tuesday to Saturday from 18:00; Parker opens at 21:00. Both close late depending on the event. Closed Sundays and Mondays.
hero.reservationQ: Do I need a reservation to get in?
hero.reservationA: Lenox doesn't require a ticket or reservation — entry is first-come, first-served, subject to availability. For Parker (the concerts) you do need to buy a ticket online. Only Cool Cat Club members have early reservation access.

venue.title: About the venue
venue.diffQ: What's the difference between Parker and Lenox?
venue.diffA: Lenox is the entry listening bar — relaxed and open to the public. Parker is the inner club where live concerts and special experiences happen.
venue.liveQ: Is there live music every night?
venue.liveA: Yes, Tuesday to Saturday. Check our lineup for who's playing each night.
venue.whereA: General Prim 100, corner with Milán 14, Colonia Juárez, Mexico City. One block from Reforma.
venue.parkingQ: Do you have parking or valet?
venue.parkingA: We don't have our own parking, but there are metered spots and paid lots within two blocks.

tickets.title: Tickets & entry
tickets.howA: Online from this site, or at the club box office subject to availability.
tickets.groupsA: Yes. We recommend buying tickets in advance and letting us know so we can set aside a table. For private experiences, contact us directly.
tickets.soldoutQ: What if I arrive without tickets and it's full?
tickets.soldoutA: At Lenox we'll add you to a waitlist. For Parker, you can check online if tickets are still available.
tickets.coverQ: Is there an entrance fee for the concerts?
tickets.coverA: Depends on the event. Some have an entrance fee, others like the Tuesday Jams are free. Check the lineup.

night.title: Show night
night.lenoxA: No reservations or entrance fee. Seating is first-come, first-served, subject to availability.
night.saturdayQ: How do Saturday double shows work?
night.saturdayA: Some Saturdays we run two shows of the same artist (19:30 and 22:30). The first is 60 min, the second is 90. First set tickets: entry from 19:00, exit 30 min after the show. Second set tickets: entry at 22:00, stay until closing.
night.includesQ: What does the entrance fee include?
night.includesA: Access to the club and the live show. Food and drinks inside are paid separately.
night.afterQ: Can I stay after the show?
night.afterA: Of course. Parker stays open and the night continues with great music and atmosphere.

policies.title: Purchase Policy
policies.addressValue: Calle Gral. Prim 100, Juárez, Cuauhtémoc, 06600 Mexico City
policies.item1: With your ticket you secure entry and a seat. Tables are assigned based on arrival order and party size. Entry to the show area begins at 21:00, except Saturdays (19:00 and 22:00 depending on the set).
policies.item2: Arrival window for paid ticket holders is 18:00 to 21:30. Seats of those who don't arrive by 21:30 may be reassigned to other guests already at the venue.
policies.item3prefix: If you can't make the event, you can reschedule for another date within the next 30 days, as long as you cancel before 22:00 the day of the event via WhatsApp
policies.item4: Saturdays feature two sets. First set ticket holders can enter Parker from 19:00 and exit 30 min after the show. Second set ticket holders enter at 22:00 and can stay until closing.
policies.item5: If you're a Cool Cat Club member, apply your coupon before completing your ticket or product purchase.
policies.item6prefix: For any special request, message us on WhatsApp at

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.legalDisclaimer: This is an informational translation of our Privacy Notice. The legally binding version remains the Spanish original, in accordance with the Mexican Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP).
privacy.section1Body: Dos Con Todo, S.A. de C.V., commercially known as Parker & Lenox (hereinafter, "Parker & Lenox"), with address at Milán 14, Colonia Juárez, C.P. 06600, Mexico City, is responsible for the use, processing, and protection of your personal data.
privacy.section2Intro: For the purposes stated in this notice, we may collect:
privacy.section2Item1: Identification and contact data: name, email, and phone (when applicable).
privacy.section2Item2: Data of companions (name and email, if applicable) that you provide when purchasing tickets.
privacy.section2Item3: Information about your purchases, reservations, and event attendance.
privacy.section2Item4: Browsing data collected automatically via cookies and similar technologies (see section 6).
privacy.section2Outro: Your card or payment method data is processed directly by our payment provider (Stripe) and is not stored by Parker & Lenox.
privacy.section3Item1: Process, confirm, and deliver ticket purchases and reservations.
privacy.section3Item2: Send tickets, confirmations, and communications related to your purchase or event.
privacy.section3Item3: Manage access and seat assignment at the event.
privacy.section3Item4: Provide customer support, clarifications, refunds, and billing.
privacy.section4Intro: Additionally, unless you object, we will use your data to:
privacy.section4Item1: Send promotions, newsletters, event invitations, and marketing communications.
privacy.section4Item2: Conduct surveys, statistics, and market studies.
privacy.section4Item3: Build profiles and segments for advertising purposes.
privacy.section4Item4: Create audiences and advertising/remarketing campaigns on third-party platforms such as Meta Platforms (Facebook and Instagram) and Google, including hashed matching of your email for these platforms.
privacy.section4OutroPrefix: If you don't want your personal data used for these secondary purposes, you can express it by emailing
privacy.section4OutroSuffix: . Your refusal will not be grounds to deny you the services you request.
privacy.section5Intro: Your personal data may be shared with:
privacy.section5Item1: Providers offering services required for our operations: payment processing (Stripe), email delivery, and technology hosting.
privacy.section5Item2: Advertising platforms (Meta Platforms, Inc. and Google) for marketing purposes, when you have consented to the secondary purposes.
privacy.section5Outro: Transfers necessary to fulfill the legal relationship with you do not require your consent, per article 37 of the LFPDPPP. Transfers for advertising purposes are only made with your consent.
privacy.section6Title: 6. Use of cookies, web beacons, and tracking technologies
privacy.section6Body: Our website uses cookies, web beacons, and pixels (including the Meta pixel and Google tools) that collect data about your browsing — such as pages visited, interactions, and device type — for analytics and advertising purposes. You can disable cookies from your browser settings, keeping in mind this may affect your site experience.
privacy.section7Body1: You have the right to Access your personal data, Rectify it when inaccurate, Cancel it when you consider it's no longer needed, or Oppose its processing, as well as to revoke your consent or limit the use or disclosure of your data.
privacy.section7Body2Prefix: To exercise any of these rights, send your request to
privacy.section7Body2Suffix: , including: (i) your full name, (ii) a clear description of the request, and (iii) a contact method to reach you.
privacy.section8Body: We reserve the right to modify or update this Privacy Notice at any time. Any change will be published on this same page.
privacy.section9Body: By providing your personal data and/or using our services and website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and accepted the terms of this Privacy Notice, and grant your consent for the processing of your data in accordance with the purposes described herein.
